title.narrative: Fostering policies for the integrated development of seven value chains

description.narrative: The project will support the Government of Venezuela in improving livelihoods of rural communities in an inclusive and sustainable manner by raising income and increasing employment along prioritized value chains. The project will promote integrated and sustainable value chain development, involving actors along the value chains (VC), to attain increased production and higher profitability and, thereby, facilitate import substitution and access to new and better markets. To this end, during the initial phase of the project, integrated value chain diagnostics will be developed for 7 prioritized value chains to identify main bottlenecks and opportunities for development in each of the prioritized value chains will be identified. Based on the findings of the diagnostics, action plans for each of the seven value chains will be developed. During the implementation phase of the project the previously designed action plan for integrated value chain development will be implemented.
